Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — BlueWater is excited to kick off the 8-week pilot with Redwood. Before we start, finance at our end asked whether Redwood requires a Purchase Order (PO) for pilot invoices. Our standard is to send invoices without a PO for pilots under $10k, but we wanted to confirm Redwood's preference so we can route invoices correctly.

Two quick asks:
- Can Redwood accept invoices without a PO for this pilot (anticipated total $6,500)?
- If not, is there a temporary exception process we can use so billing doesn't block kickoff?

I've attached our onboarding form and the preliminary statement of work.

Hi team — I reviewed the SOW and onboarding form. Procurement can approve a provisional no-PO exception for the pilot on the following conditions:

1) BlueWater returns the completed PO-exception-form and the onboarding form signed by an authorized representative.
2) Total invoiced amount for the pilot must not exceed $10,000. Any overage requires a formal PO.
3) Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice receipt to Redwood AP (invoice must be emailed to accounting@redwood.ai).
4) Vendor must accept Redwood's Master Services Agreement (MSA) terms; if BlueWater needs redlines, route them to legal@redwood.ai — note redline review may delay onboarding.

If BlueWater meets these conditions, Procurement will mark this as a temporary exception (60 days) and will create an internal memo in SUP-1220 for audit trail. Please include the signed exception form as evidence.

Reference: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-1220

I'll approve the waiver in our system once I receive the signed form. Evelyn — please confirm you will collect the completed form from the vendor and reply-all with it attached.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
